description: This file contains internal implementation details for Abseil's container library, including templates for node handles, type traits, and internal API structures.

classes.name: node_handle_base
classes.description: Base class for node handles, managing resource transfer and destruction for container nodes.

classes.name: node_handle
classes.description: Template class for node handles in sets and maps, providing access to stored elements.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the node's resource if not empty.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the node handle, releasing its resource.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns a reference to the value stored in the node handle (for set nodes).

methods.name: mapped
methods.description: Returns a reference to the mapped value (for map nodes).
